parsed.rationale: Both participating records in this cluster have `is_test: true` and reside in the same test file `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift` within the `Artwork` package. Although the Jaccard similarity of 0.828 indicates structurally similar test bodies, `fetchAlbumArtworkSuccess` and `skipsSpacerGifImages` are distinct test scenarios (a success path vs. a spacer-GIF filtering path) whose structural resemblance is a natural consequence of sharing the same test harness setup and assertion patterns. Collapsing or abstracting them risks obscuring the distinct intent of each test case, reducing readability and debuggability.
